content:
Jennifer Lopez has no quarrels about living the single life ― but she recently admitted her divorce from longtime partner Ben Affleck was “so disappointing.”

“It was such a hard, disappointing last situation on every level,” she said Tuesday on the “Friends Keep Secrets” podcast. “On every level, it was so disappointing. I just don’t ever want to delve into that [again].”

Lopez clarified she’s still open to finding her soulmate after co-host Lil Dicky (who’s real name is Dave Burd) asked her if she meant that she never wanted to fall in love again.

Lopez and Affleck dated from 2002 to 2004, rekindled their relationship in 2021, and wed in 2022, nearly 20 years after their first split. Lopez filed for divorce from the “Animals” actor in August 2024, and the divorce was finalized in February 2025.

Declaring she’s totally “done with that part of my life,” Lopez described herself as a “serial monogamist,” and noted she was always searching for “the thing” that would complete her love life.

Lopez then shared advice for navigating a divorce.

“I think my advice for divorce is my advice for everything, which is always [to] operate in a way that you’ll feel proud of when you look back. Because I can look back at these situations and be like, even as painful as some of them were … so bad, like life shifting pain and hurt, I can look back and be like, ‘I loved completely.’”

Lopez shared she can reflect on her past relationships and know she behaved in a way that she’s “proud of as a human.”

“I didn’t treat anybody in any ways that I would be ashamed of, you know. I always tried in the moment. I did the best that I could in the moment with what I knew. And I think that’s my advice for anything because when you go through hard things like that, it’s easy to kind of be like, ‘fuck this.’”
